learning_outcomes.text: Teach fundamental concepts and principles of electricity and magnetism based on mathematics to science and engineering students at the undergraduate level.
Reveal the relationship between mathematics, physics, and engineering sciences.
Ensure the acquisition of knowledge of electricity and magnetism in daily life and engineering applications.
Bring students to a level where they can use this knowledge in specialized courses belonging to their main disciplines.
Enable students to acquire analytical thinking ability.

syllabus_topics: Historical development of electricity and magnetism
Electric fields created by charged systems
